notes: The parts list is unchanged from step 1; step 1 was correct.
Each physical connection has a joined and an electrical edge between the same ports.

Breadboard hole numbers are read from the image and are approximate. The 5V side of the buttons is on the 'b' bank (the image's upper half, rows f-j). The signal and pull-down side is on the 't' bank (the image's lower half, rows a-e).
Each pushbutton straddles the centre gap, two columns wide. Side 1 (1.l, 1.r) is on the 5V strips. Side 2 (2.l, 2.r) is on the signal strip.
The red 5V wire goes to the top + rail (tp). The black GND wire goes to the bottom - rail (bn), as in the image. The five 10k pull-down resistors run from each signal column to that bottom - rail.
Signal wires go to pins 6, 5, 4, 3 and 2 for buttons 1 to 5. Each lands on the same strip as the button's side 2 and its pull-down resistor.
GND.1 is used for the Leonardo ground pin. The image shows the GND next to 5V.
